# SD13-E5 deterministic Human Rogue level 4 progression fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD13-E3/E5 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Rogue
# level-1/level-2/level-3 chassis baseline to level 4 as chosen input only. It
# names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or parity values.
# It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam (ability-bonus and
# bonus-feat) and the deterministic ability/feat/skill posture from the
# level-1/level-2/level-3 fixtures, adding only the level bump this bounded
# tranche needs. Rogue grants no talent choice-slot line here (rogue talents
# are a level-2+ choice-list feature this slice deliberately does not
# implement — a genuinely open-ended talent tree, not a flat arithmetic
# burden), so no new choice= line is required beyond the level-1/level-2/
# level-3 baseline.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Rogue burden surface: no check-execution
# engine, no trap DC resolution, no magic-trap disarm engine, no rogue
# talent, and no level-5+ progression. Uncanny Dodge (the 4th-level rogue
# class feature this fixture newly exercises) is grounded only as a bounded
# identity/recognition record, never applied to any actual flat-footed-state
# tracking or Armor Class computation.

class_level=class:rogue:4
